note: Extra permission rules for this repository.
This file can only ADD rules, and can only make an existing rule STRICTER. It
cannot switch a built-in rule off or downgrade a refusal to an allow.
That is deliberate, and it is not about distrusting the engineer: the assistant
itself has write access to this file. A safety file that a session can edit its way
out of is not a safety file. The built-in rules live in src/hm_oi/permissions.py
and are always applied on top of whatever is written here.
rule_id   a short name, shown to the person when the rule stops something
pattern   a Python regular expression, matched case-insensitively
reason    plain words, printed when the rule fires - write it for someone
mid-task who does not know why they were stopped
